# `components/MaterialPanel.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/components/MaterialPanel.js`

MaterialPanel.js - Material Studio Panel Composes Library + PBR Inspector + 3D Preview into an overlay panel. Follows the Sound Studio (AudioEditorPanel.js) architecture.

## Functions

### `createMaterialPanel(container, options = {})`

Create the material panel contents inside the overlay body.

**Parameters:**

- `container` *(HTMLElement)* — #material-studio-body element
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.materialLibrary` *(Object)* — MaterialLibrary instance
- `options.textureManager` *(Object)* — TextureManager instance
- `options.editorApp` *(Object)* — Editor reference for entity assignment

**Returns:** Panel instance

### `destroyMaterialPanel(panel)`

Destroy the material panel.

**Parameters:**

- `panel` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
